g.text: 1. Function: microSD socket on SDMMC0 (UHS-I SDR104 at 1.8 V signalling).

g.text: 2. Absent state: card absent is normal: SD_DET_N high through the SoC pull-up; while it is

g.desc: high SDMMC0 carries UART2/JTAG M1 (HDG p. 20).

g.text: 3. 22 Ω series on every line, 100 Ω on detect (HDG p. 52); TPD4E05U06 (0.5 pF) at the socket.
